scenes.title: Fancy Friday med Næsebladet
scenes.alt: Næsebladet i brokadevest og butterfly står på et dirigentpodie i et tomt teater og løfter en teske som taktstok.

Næsebladet is the guest conductor in a candle-warm Art Deco music hall on a formal Friday. Dramatic wing silhouette and nose, ears and face stay unchanged; bat wings emerge directly from shoulders through the tailored vest. At a raised varnished conductor's podium, he lifts one small silver teaspoon as a baton using the natural little claw at the folded wing's edge, with a stern look as if someone ruined the opening note. Glowing brass footlights, warm red velvet seats empty behind, honey-color parquet, and a dark ochre stage wall with tasteful abstract gold deco lines.
